thread:
elaine: Quick sync — we need to make a call on which post-launch items land in 1.1 vs go into the backlog. We have a mix of customer-driven asks and a few stability bugs. Can folks drop quick takes and owners?

devin: short answer: ship critical bug fixes + 1 small QoL enhancement. anything bigger delays the ship. :thumbsup:

raj: +1. we should firm up launch criteria (latency P95, error rate, regressions on evals) before we expand scope.

marta: listing the top items I heard from CS this week:
- customer A: explicit request for fine-grained routing policy UI (requested for enterprise demo)
- customer B: caching inconsistencies under burst loads (repro'd in staging)
- internal: model rollback UX (manual today)

ken: rough estimates: routing UI ~ 6 dev-days + 2 design days; caching bug likely 4-8 dev-days depending on root cause; rollback UX ~3 dev-days.

elaine: Can we map those to a simple triage? here’s a proposal:
```
P0: crashes / data-loss / security/regulatory blockers
P1: correctness/regression that impacts customers or safety
P2: perf/latency issues that break SLOs for >5% of requests
P3: UX/enhancements or big new features
```

devin: that triage works. caching issue -> P1 (it causes inconsistent responses under burst), routing UI -> P3 for general availability but P2 for enterprise demo (if demo is blocked). rollback UX -> P2 (reduces recovery time).

raj: suggest adding measurable launch criteria to avoid scope creep:
- Latency: P95 < 450ms for text-gen baseline
- Errors: 5xx < 0.3%
- Regression delta on core evals < 2% negative

marta: noted. For enterprise demo we can carve out a targeted canary: routing UI in a canary flag for demo customers only. That keeps GA scope smaller.

ken: timeline check: we have one sprint (2 weeks) before the follow-on release window. If we only take P0+P1+rollback UX, devs can land by EOW sprint with small QA. Adding routing UI will push to next window.

elaine: Decision proposal: 1) 1.1 GA includes P0 + P1 + rollback UX (P2/P3 deferred), 2) Enterprise demo gets canary flag for minimal routing hook + docs, 3) route full routing UI to 1.2. Agree? :thinking:

devin: agree from infra side, that keeps perf targets sane.

raj: agree. I’ll own validating the eval/regression numbers pre-merge.

marta: I’ll tell CS and prepare the canary notes + acceptance criteria for demo customers.

ken: I’ll split the tasks and add dev estimates to the ticket.

release-bot: Deploy window reminder — next safe deploy: 2026-04-01 02:00 UTC. Please mark tickets as ready by 2026-03-28 to hit that.

elaine: ACTIONS:
- raj: run regression/eval checklist and post results in this thread by 1795004500
- ken: break tickets + dev estimates by EOD tomorrow
- marta: update CS and create canary doc
- dev team: focus on P0/P1 + rollback UX for this window

devin: any objections to cutting the routing UI for GA?

marta: no objections. customers prefer a reliable GA over a half-baked UI.

elaine: ok locking decision. We’ll reconvene after raj posts evals. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
